request: Manual five-topic batch, fifteen complete versions;1500–2500 visible body words per language, original sourced guides, official GTA VI imagery and preserved existing pages.

execution.network: Existing managed proxy and normal verified TLS; approved outer cloud execution for network/preview/browser when basic sandbox restricts access.
execution.credentials: Existing configured connections only; no new credentials, payments, account changes or third-party messages.

selection.method: Full current catalogue and translated intents compared; closest complete articles inspected. New guides link existing announcements and core guides without replacing them.
selection.decisions: Five distinct complementary intents; no update or deletion of the214existing article objects.

Google_Trends_US_related.finding: Leading related queries concern broad topics already represented in the catalogue. They do not establish a top-five ranking for these new guides.

search_interest.limits: Spain and France returned429 and were not retried. Current qualitative coverage and task-specific search results support complementary selection; no absolute volume, five-most-searched claim, guaranteed traffic, rapid indexing or Google position is asserted.

visible_word_counts.method: Unicode tokens, apostrophes retained; real visible body prose, H2/H3 and tables only. Excludes duplicated body alias, title/excerpt, alt/captions and citation labels.

independent_editorial_and_source_review.scope: Editorial/deduplication/source-budget approval of five raw Article JSON snapshots only. Runtime/build/deployment/public URL checks remain parent responsibilities.

peer_review.scope: Full ES prose, EN/FR factual segments, exact source paths/counts and density independently reviewed.

independent_editorial_and_source_review.source_count_rule: All ES/EN/FR source-derived paragraphs, attributed localized metadata/headings, repeated body/title aliases where applicable and bibliography/reference labels for3renders. Locale variants/mirrors/grouped venue policies share one work allowance. Public source recaps prohibited beyond reserved words.

allowed_after_raw_snapshot_approval: Root cover image/imageAlt/imageCaption/imageCredit fields from verified plan
Two inline section.image objects from verified plan
Official Rockstar media bibliography credit if absent
explicit_media_only_allowlist.not_allowed: Any prose, source-derived facts, heading, slug, metadata date or existing-article/related-map change without renewed review.

independent_editorial_and_source_review.interest_evidence_limits: Actual US Trends data available to root; ES/FR429with no retries. Existing popular core intents already covered. Selected complementary long-tail guides use current coverage/primary verification, not a verified top5search ranking.

integrated_snapshot.reviewed_content: Only the three explicitly reviewed image records and shared official-media bibliography link were attached after semantic peer review; prose, metadata, dates, H2/H3/FAQ and internal links unchanged.
integrated_snapshot.equivalent_editorial_update: Two approved English synonym substitutions; no facts, counts, slugs or dates changed. Generated utility-candidate side effect removed without build/configuration changes.

media.reuse: Official promotional imagery offered for download/share, used for contextual editorial illustration with credits and original links. Copyright reserved; no unrestricted licence claimed.
media.network: Managed cloud, normal verified TLS and inherited proxy. No credential used for source requests.
media.limits: Images illustrate GTA VI, not real store events, consoles, hardware menus or a diagnostic result. No publication binaries changed.

preservation.tracked_preservation_method: Strict Git blob SHA-1 comparison for every baseline-map entry, with no exceptions.

validation.verify_static:
Verified 701 HTML files, 31694 internal links and 1376 structured-data blocks.
SEO verified: 657 article URLs, 696 canonical sitemap entries, reciprocal hreflang, initial HTML paragraphs and article links.
Editorial audit: 219 topics, 657 language URLs, 458 media uses; 0 errors and 42 review notices.
validation.initial_image_check: The first desktop/mobile run passed20cases and had2mobile decode assertions before an explicit resource-readiness wait. Both failed cases passed unchanged sequentially; all image variants independently decoded. The final test retains strict decoding and waits for complete/naturalWidth/currentSrc before it. Final22desktop/mobile and3tablet checks repeated after this harness adjustment.
validation.browser_engine: Chromium cloud emulation in desktop,mobile and tablet; physical devices and Safari not certified.
validation.SDK_limit: Only provider SDKs are fixtures in deterministic content checks; real advertising creatives and Analytics receipt are not certified.

abandoned_candidate.operation: Bulk official-manufacturer support GET rejected by automatic approval review as outside the current GTA6publication scope.
abandoned_candidate.handling: No retry or workaround; candidate abandoned. A distinct GTA6event logistics topic and new relevant-source operation were accepted.

build_preservation_note.cause: The automatic style scanner interpreted one English prose term as a utility candidate. Two equivalent editorial substitutions removed the unintended generated rule; no CSS, JavaScript or build-configuration source changed.
build_preservation_note.final_strict_asset_comparison: All three asset names and bytes match the hash-pinned published baseline after the equivalent text change.

scope_controls: No design, old article, old URL, related-link algorithm/data, CSS/JS, ad unit, consent, cache, security, subscription, other-project or automation-frequency change. New entries appear through the existing sitemap/category systems.
source_budget_rule: Public evidence stores URLs, hashes, timestamps, counts and decisions only; private source bodies and assigned segment text are not committed or restated.
publication: Pending confirmed GitHub commit, explicit Cloudflare deployment and public verification.
